risks.explanation: This document carries JavaScript inside it. Nexus never runs a document's script, so it cannot do anything here.
This document has something set to happen when it is opened. Nexus ignores it and simply shows the pages.
This document carries another file inside it. Nexus does not open or extract attachments.
This document uses an XFA form, which is a separate format inside the PDF. Nexus does not render XFA, so those parts will not appear.
This document contains links to the internet. Nexus is offline and will not follow one. Common in lecture slides.
